en: Vintage sepia-toned winter scene showing a snow-covered canal or river lined with bare trees on both sides. A lone figure stands on the frozen waterway. In the background there is a tall, square tower with a domed roof rising above the trees, likely part of a historic building. The lower part of the card has printed and stamped text in Swedish, including references to Uddevalla Museum and the date Feb. 1903.
